directAnswer: ADU contractor SEO is the work of helping a business rank in search so the right homeowners find it. For Canadian businesses that means focused service pages, a strong Google Business Profile, and province-aware content that helps someone searching in their own city book with you.
intro: Because Canada is ten provinces with their own competition and their own vocabulary, the content has to reflect the places a business actually serves. Adu contractors that treat search as a system, with focused pages and a well-built Google Business Profile, consistently outperform those with one catch-all page. People searching for an ADU contractor often compare a few options and decide on fit, availability and proof rather than price alone. A general homepage rarely wins the searches that matter; the pages that do are tied to a project, a community and a clear next step. An ADU contractor that ranks well nationally usually ranks well because each local page underneath is genuinely useful on its own. The businesses that grow from search are the ones whose pages answer a real question before asking for the call.
localInsight: Search demand shifts by province, so a national strategy has to be assembled from strong local pages, not the other way around. Consistent name, address and phone details across the web matter because homeowners cross-check before they contact you. Trust content works best when it respects privacy and stays within the advertising rules of each profession. A complete Google Business Profile with the right category, services and service area is the foundation in every province. Because directories are strong nationally, the most durable gains come from owning specific, high-intent searches in each city. In Quebec, clients often search in French, and the Charter of the French Language makes a French-language presence a practical expectation.
localChecklist: A structure that links the Canada page to provinces and cities.
Province-aware wording that matches what you may legally say in each region.
Location pages that describe the communities you serve without copying one page nationwide.
Fast, mobile-friendly pages that make the next step obvious.
A service page for each project you actually offer, written for homeowners.
Clear intake information: how to book, what happens first, and how pricing works.

faqs.q: Which projects can you write about?
faqs.a: We write only about what you genuinely offer. Common examples include permit and design coordination, project management, secondary suite compliance and garage conversions. We do not invent services or make claims a business cannot stand behind.

faqs.q: How long before a business sees results?
faqs.a: Local visibility usually starts improving within three to six months, with more meaningful gains between six and twelve. Timelines depend on your current site, the competition in your city, and how consistently content and profile work is maintained.

faqs.q: Why do directory sites outrank my own website?
faqs.a: Large directories and marketplaces have enormous authority, so they often sit above a single business for broad terms. The strategy is not to fight them for a generic word but to win the specific searches that describe your work, your homeowners and your location.

faqs.q: Do you work with businesses in every province?
faqs.a: Yes. We build pages for Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, and Prince Edward Island, and we link each province page to the cities we cover inside it.

Request a free quote and we will review your website, your Google Business Profile and the terms you want to rank for. From there we recommend the pages and profile work that will move your business forward first.

ADU contractor SEO is search optimisation built for Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) Contractors, combining technical fixes, service-focused content, local visibility and Google Business Profile work so that someone searching for help nearby can find and choose your business.

summary: ADU Contractor SEO in Canada. Local search, Google Business Profile work and province-aware pages that help businesses across Canada get found.
